headSymmetry.note: The geometry is square by construction (halfWidth == halfHeight == 0.366); the rendered diamond reads 8% wider than tall because the camera looks slightly down and the bottom corner seats 0.03 into the neck collar. The display's own mirror figure (18%) measures the lit face content on the screen, not the casing.

themePenetration.method: scratch themepen2.mjs — over the CHARACTER ONLY. Mask: groups debug view at tier low with every scene child but the character root hidden (16-theme-body-mask-*.png); body = 16.2% of the frame. Secondary = body pixels with the theme hue (±32°), saturation ≥ 0.28, luma 18..150 (reflection, rims, seams, bounce, transmission). Primary = same hue at luma ≥ 150 (emitters). Quarters are top→bottom of the character's bounding box: head+traps, chest+deltoids+upper arms, abdomen+forearms+hands, taper.

levers.crystalOwnHue: uCrystalTint — the facets' own hue is the canonical sapphire under every theme (R100 let uTint into the diffuse mix: paint). This is why gold's abdomen quarter FELL 14.4 → 9.8: R100's gold there was painted facets.
levers.measuredNoOpsForGold: coat reflection tint 0.26 → 0.34 and directional rim 0.62 → 0.70 moved gold by 0.04 points (reverted); seams 0.36 → 0.38 and coat rim mix 0.50 → 0.58 kept (small, in the brief's direction).
levers.theLeverThatWorked: coreStrength 2.0 → 3.6 (the core's transmission, added in the theme's own colour where the crystal is dark): gold 18.65 → 22.30, purple 35.34 → 39.63, blue 75.68 → 77.04; the blue waist crop at 2.0 vs 3.6 is 16-theme-core-light-waist-2.0-vs-3.6.png.

themePenetration.earlierFigureRetracted: Numbers reported during passes C/D (blue 34.6, gold 6.2–8.6, purple 10.8–12.2) were taken over a mask that was mostly stage background (56% of the frame) and are withdrawn; the relative direction they showed was right, the magnitudes were diluted three to one.

environmentReadability.method: scratch envread.mjs on the no-character showcase capture (r95-world-showcase-nochar.png, 746x1400; R100 from git HEAD, R101 from this build). Range band rows 0.55–0.66: mean luma in the centre 38% of columns (behind him) over the outer 24% each side (flanks).
environmentReadability.note: The darkening behind him is real and modest (3% relative) because the horizon mist in that band is uniform and dominates the mean. The spire beam at column 0.42 sits behind the torso in the front view.

motionReadability.method: scratch motion.mjs — six yaw steps over 0.3 rad, luminance histogram over the character's own pixels
